description: Search mail with Gmail query syntax (from:, to:, subject:, is:unread, has:attachment, after:2026/10/01, newer_than:7d, label:, in:inbox ...). Searches ALL connected accounts by default and merges the results newest-first, each tagged with its account; the same email found in several accounts is shown once (see "alsoIn"). Pass "account" to narrow it. Returns headers + snippet; use read_email for the full body. IMAP accounts support the common operators.

account.description: Which mailbox(es): an alias, an email address, a list of them, or "all". Omit to use ALL connected accounts. No accounts connected yet.

includeSpamTrash.description: Also search Spam and Trash (default false).

pageToken.description: Continue a previous single-account search (from nextPageTokens).

query.description: Search query, e.g. "is:unread newer_than:2d" or "from:dhl.com has:attachment". Use "" for latest mail.

name: search_emails
title: Search emails (one or many accounts)
